value.rationale: The natural entire clique-prism family exhibits a structural mixed-dimensional wedge arising from chessboard cores plus otherwise isolated matching edges. The complete rational group character gives symmetry invariants invisible in the rank formula, notably a constant layer-swap trace in third homology, and the integral H1 action records orientation reversal. Classification applies to every n>=5 rather than an arbitrary or hand-picked finite graph.
